title: Sublet Offer
teaser: A message from someone in your contacts — subletting their place in Williamsburg for four months.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A message from someone in your contacts — not a close friend, an acquaintance, the kind you have a dozen of in this city. They're subletting their place in Williamsburg for four months while they do something in Europe.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It's not cheap, but it's below market. The photos show a real living room. A kitchen with counter space. A neighborhood with a coffee shop you've been to once and liked.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: They need to know by Friday.

choices.label: Take the sublet — make the move
Pass — the timing isn't right
Ask for the weekend to think about it

title: Recruiter Ping
teaser: A recruiter connected with you on LinkedIn. This happens. You usually ignore it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A recruiter connected with you on LinkedIn. This happens. You usually ignore it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: But you looked at this one. The company is real. The role is a step up. The salary range listed is more than you're making now — more than you expected.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You've been at your current job for a while. You've had the thought. This might be the thing that answers it.

choices.label: Reply and schedule a call
Ignore it — not the right time
Look into the company first, then decide

title: Side Hustle Takes Off
teaser: A client shared your work. That client's network is much bigger than your client.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A client shared your work. That client's network is much bigger than your client.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your inbox has four new enquiries. Three of them look legitimate. One is offering a budget that makes you read it twice.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: This is the moment. You either scale up and take on more than feels comfortable, or you keep it manageable and leave money on the table.

choices.label: Take all the work — grind season
Take one good client, decline the rest
Take a breath and set up a waitlist

title: Friend Asks to Borrow Money
teaser: Jordan has that energy. You know what this conversation is.

dialogue.speaker: jordan
dialogue.text: Okay so. You know how I had that thing lined up?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The thing with the gallery?

dialogue.speaker: jordan
dialogue.text: The thing with the gallery. Yeah. So it's happening, it's definitely happening, but there's a materials cost that I didn't fully account for and I'm like — two hundred short.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Jordan.

dialogue.speaker: jordan
dialogue.text: I know. I know. I would not be asking if I had literally any other option. I have looked at every other option. This is the only option.

dialogue.speaker: jordan
dialogue.text: I will pay you back by the end of the month.

choices.label: Lend the $200
Lend $100 — half now, half when you have it
Decline — you can't right now

title: Viral Moment
teaser: That thing you posted — the one you didn't think twice about — has 40,000 views.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: That thing you posted — the one you didn't think twice about — has 40,000 views.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: This is the internet. There's no logic. Someone shared it. Someone else shared that. Now your notifications are a sound like a distant waterfall and people are tagging you in things.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: This will last approximately 48 hours. The question is what you do with it.

choices.label: Post a follow-up while the attention is there
Quietly enjoy it and let it pass
Turn the attention toward something real — promote your work, your hustle

title: Family Needs Money
teaser: A message from home. Your mother is being careful with her words.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A message from home. Your mother is being careful with her words, the way she always is when she doesn't want you to worry.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The car needs a repair. The repair costs more than she has this month. She will figure it out, she says. She always figures it out, she says.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: She is not asking.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You know she is asking.

choices.label: Send the full amount she needs — $350
Send what you can right now — $150
Call and talk about it, figure out another way

title: Local Business Needs a Website
teaser: Carlos leans over the counter. 'Hey. You know computers, right?'

dialogue.speaker: carlos
dialogue.text: Hey. You know computers, right?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sort of. Depends what you need.

dialogue.speaker: carlos
dialogue.text: My cousin's restaurant — two blocks over, the Dominican place — she needs a website. She's been paying this guy four hundred dollars a year for something that looks like it was built in 2007.

dialogue.speaker: carlos
dialogue.text: She said she'd pay someone to fix it. Five hundred. She wants it to look real.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: ...I could take a look at it.

dialogue.speaker: carlos
dialogue.text: I told her you'd say yes.

choices.label: Take the job
Refer someone else instead
Decline — not your thing right now

title: Coworker Quits, Role Opens Up
teaser: Priya catches you in the hallway. 'Did you hear about Marcus?'

dialogue.speaker: priya
dialogue.text: Did you hear about Marcus?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I heard something.

dialogue.speaker: priya
dialogue.text: He's leaving. Got an offer somewhere else. Which means his role is going to be posted internally before it goes external.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: How do you know all this?

dialogue.speaker: priya
dialogue.text: I know things. The point is — you should apply. You'd be good at it. And you'd actually get a real title.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They'd consider me?

dialogue.speaker: priya
dialogue.text: I'd put in a word. If you want me to.

choices.label: Apply. Let Priya put in the word.
Apply on your own, no favour
Don't apply — not ready yet

title: Gym Closes
teaser: There's a sign on the door. A paper sign, printed at home, slightly crooked.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's a sign on the door. A paper sign, printed at home, slightly crooked. 'Permanently Closed. Thank you for your support.'

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your gym is gone. It lasted longer than most, but the rent finally did what rent does in this city.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You had a routine. You had a locker. You knew which treadmill tracked wrong and avoided it. That is all gone now.

choices.label: Find a new gym immediately — don't break the habit
Switch to running outside — it's free
Take it as a sign to rest for a while

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the sidewalk. Just there. A twenty dollar bill, folded once, slightly damp, clearly not claimed by anyone in the immediate vicinity.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You look around. Nothing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: This is yours now. That is how it works.

choices.label: Pocket it — finder's fee
Leave it where it is — someone will need it more
Give it to the person outside the subway entrance
